newsitem.title: UK: Tadpole shares drop after full-year loss.
newsitem.headline: Tadpole shares drop after full-year loss.

text.p: Shares of Tadpole Technology Plc slid by nearly 13 percent on Friday after the notebook computer maker announced a loss in the year ended September 30 due to flat sales revenue.
Tadpole shares fell 5p to 34-1/2 in volume of 103,702 shares, after the group announced a 4.37 million stg loss against a 9.95 million stg loss last year.
"Tight cost control was maintained during the second half of the year but actual revenues were insufficient to improve profitability during the period," chairman Richard King said.
He said the benefits of costly internal restructuring and strategic decisions at Tadpole should begin to show in the 1997 financial year.
Turnover dropped to 23.9 million stg from 24.2 million.
